description: This file contains abstract classes and interfaces for testing serialization and copying mechanisms within the Orleans.Serialization.TestKit namespace. It defines test base classes for copy and field codec testing, along with related utility structures and interfaces.

classes.name: CopierTester
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing deep copying of values with a specified copier type, providing common setup, configuration, and assertions.

classes.name: FieldCodecTester
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing field codecs, supporting round-trip serialization, skipping, and buffer handling tests.

classes.name: ValueTypeFieldCodecTester
classes.description: Derived class for testing codecs specific to value types, including direct and standard serializer round-trips.

classes.name: IOutputBuffer
classes.description: Interface representing an output buffer capable of providing a read-only sequence of bytes.

classes.name: ReadOnlySequenceHelper
classes.description: Utility static class with methods for batching and creating ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances.

classes.name: TestBufferWriterStruct
classes.description: Implementation of IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer for testing buffer writing with fixed byte arrays.

classes.name: TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter
classes.description: Implementation of IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer supporting multiple segments for testing advanced buffer scenarios.

methods.name: CanCopyCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Test method to verify copying collections via serializer.

methods.name: CanCopyCollectionViaUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Test method to verify copying collections with untyped serializer.

methods.name: CanCopyTupleViaSerializer
methods.description: Test method to verify copying tuples via serializer.

methods.name: CanCopyUntypedTupleViaSerializer
methods.description: Test method for copying untyped tuples via serializer.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Hook for configuring serializers or builders, can be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: CopiedValuesAreEqual
methods.description: Test to verify if copied values are equal to original values.

methods.name: CreateCopier
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the copier used in tests.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Abstract method to create test values.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Method to compare two values for equality.

methods.name: ReferencesAreAddedToCopyContext
methods.description: Test to verify that references are properly registered in the copy context.

methods.name: CanRoundTripCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Test for serializing and deserializing collections via serializer.

methods.name: CanRoundTripDefaultValueViaCodec
methods.description: Test for serializing/deserializing default values via codec.

methods.name: CanRoundTripTupleViaSerializer
methods.description: Test for round-tripping tuples via serializer.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaObjectSerializer
methods.description: Test for round-tripping with object serializer.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer
methods.description: Test to ensure data remains consistent after serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Array
methods.description: Test for array serialization round-trip.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Memory
methods.description: Test for memory-based serialization round-trip.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_MemoryStream
methods.description: Test for stream-based serialization round-trip.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_ReadByteByByte
methods.description: Test for byte-by-byte deserialization correctness.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Span
methods.description: Test for span-based serialization round-trip.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_StreamPooled
methods.description: Test for pooled stream serialization round-trip.

methods.name: CanRoundTripWeaklyTypedCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Test for deserialization of weakly typed collections.

methods.name: CanSkipDefaultValue
methods.description: Test that default values can be skipped during serialization.

methods.name: CanSkipValue
methods.description: Test that specific values can be skipped during serialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounter
methods.description: Verify that reference counters are correctly advanced during serialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounterStream
methods.description: Verify reference counter behavior during stream serialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyHandlesBuffers
methods.description: Ensure that buffer handling during serialization is correct.

methods.name: GetWriteCopy
methods.description: Get a copy suitable for writing from the input value.

methods.name: ProducesValidBitStream
methods.description: Test if serialized data produces a valid bitstream.

methods.name: RoundTrippedValuesEqual
methods.description: Check that a value serialized and then deserialized remains equal.

methods.name: RoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Serialize and then deserialize a value using the codec.

methods.name: RoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Serialize and deserialize an object using untyped serializer and output formatted bitstream.

methods.name: WritersProduceSameResults
methods.description: Test if different writers produce identical results.
